Bought out the two puffer fish paid in cash the white dude with the low cut charge me 195 when horn puffer was $70 and dog face $80 I handed him the $150 in cash he said it 195 I won’t recommend ever going here it stinks in the store the fish aren’t thriving and the lizards they’re keep aren’t full of life.

Well first I went this past weekend. When you walk in , it’s very hard to breath. It’s very hot inside, very dark and stinks very bad . The tanks are extremely dirty and animals are not well kept . They have the animals type hidden in the back in bad conditions and squished (overcrowded) into small cages and small tanks . Customer service was horrible , they seem depressed and annoyed like if they don’t want to be there. I went in for shrimp and they look sick and not thriving . There were little insects in the tank that look like leaches and I did not want to contaminate my tank so I did not buy . The whole area where the shrimp are in the front had no light so I had to use a flashlight to see and they were very high up so I asked the guy for a small ladder and he seemed annoyed . I asked what kind of shrimp they were, he did not know . Meanwhile I called about a hour ahead and he told me which shrimp they had and after asking in person he didn’t know anything about shrimp or what kind they were . I walked to the back holding my sweater over my nose and my sons nose because I had to hold my breath in there and I saw the conditions in which the animals where kept in the back and stormed out. They didn’t ask not once if I need help or anything , both guys had an attitude.
I will  never be going back here and I hope they get closed down for keeping the animals and tanks in such bad conditions. Will not recommend to anyone because you will most likely be taking home a sick animal or fish and they will die or contaminate your other fish/shrimp or animals. Please go to another aquarium or pet store in the city . There’s one on 46 Delancey in Manhattan it’s called ( Pacific Aquarium & Plant )  and it’s A1 !!! You won’t regret it . I found these guys after going to paradise aquarium. Some Petco’s are trash also for fish, only some are clean. Check that place out. The guy that works there is VERY experienced and cares about the fish and everything else.

The store is OK, but the tanks are completely lacking in cleanliness. They could do better at cleaning the tanks, which is a shame for the animals. I have no complaints about the devoured ones. A large selection of everything.
